def transform(grid):
    # Extract the framed panel and turn it upside down. The off-panel L-key
    # exchanges the colors at its two endpoints, while its corner color stays fixed.
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    keys = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0]))
            if grid[r][c] not in (0, 1) and not (r0 <= r <= r1 and c0 <= c <= c1)]
    corner = next(p for p in keys if sum(p[0] == q[0] or p[1] == q[1] for q in keys if q != p) == 2)
    ends = [p for p in keys if p != corner]
    a, b = ends[0][2], ends[1][2]
    swap = {a: b, b: a}
    return [[swap.get(grid[r][c], grid[r][c]) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
            for r in range(r1, r0 - 1, -1)]
